original_title: Echocardiography Insourcing
english_summary: This tender is for the provision of BSE accredited echocardiographers to deliver adult cardiac transthoracic echocardiogram services at Royal Cornwall Hospitals Trust (RCHT) facilities. Services include outpatient and inpatient echocardiography using RCHT's GE Echo machines, with reporting uploaded to patient electronic records.
what_they_want: BSE accredited echocardiographers to perform adult cardiac transthoracic echocardiograms (TTE) using GE Echo machines at RCHT sites including Bodmin and WCH Community Diagnostic Centres. Services include full TTE studies to BSE standards, uploading reports to Maxims EPR system, and distribution to referrers and GPs.
eligibility_requirements: Echocardiographers must be BSE (British Society of Echocardiography) accredited.

original_title: Contract Notice
english_summary: UK Health Security Agency is establishing a 4-year Dynamic Purchasing System (DPS) for COVID-19 vaccines to support future immunisation campaigns from 2024-2028. The DPS allows qualified suppliers to apply for inclusion and participate in future tender opportunities with a potential aggregate value of £1 billion, though no minimum purchase commitment is guaranteed.
what_they_want: COVID-19 vaccines (products indicated for protection from COVID-19). No specific model numbers or brands mentioned.
eligibility_requirements: Suitably qualified suppliers must apply and be accepted onto the DPS via the Atamis eTendering system before any call-off procurement is issued. Only suppliers whose DPS application has been approved and accepted at the time an ITT is issued will be eligible to submit tenders. Full qualifying criteria available through the Atamis system.

original_title: Child and Adolescent Mental Health Services (CAMHS) Dynamic Purchasing System (DPS)
buyer_name: North Staffordshire Combined Healthcare NHS Trust
english_summary: North Staffordshire Combined Healthcare NHS Trust is reopening its Dynamic Purchasing System (DPS) for Child and Adolescent Mental Health Services (CAMHS) covering North Staffordshire and Stoke on Trent. The DPS is for a 5-year period starting February 2023 and allows organizations to qualify to deliver various CAMHS services using face-to-face, digital, and blended delivery approaches.
what_they_want: Child and Adolescent Mental Health Services (CAMHS) for ages 0-25 years (primarily 0-18 years) including multi-disciplinary team approaches, strengths-based and trauma-informed care, outcome-focused support services, and multiple delivery modalities (face-to-face, digital, and blended approaches). Services must provide timely, high quality and accessible care for children, young people and their families/carers.
eligibility_requirements: Suitably experienced organisations in providing Child and Adolescent Mental Health Services. Applicants must indicate their area(s) of expertise and delivery modalities as part of the qualification process. Must register via the MLCSU Atamis eTendering System.

original_title: Mental Health Recovery

original_title: Integrated Children's Occupational Therapy Service

what_they_want: Occupational therapy services for children including: interventions supporting everyday activities (self-care, writing, learning, play); provision of Occupational Therapists for the Hackney Experts at Hand team; training and tools for parents/carers and professionals to support children with SEND; services delivered across Virtual School and Disabled Children's Service settings.

original_title: Children's Integrated Speech and Language Therapy Service
english_summary: This tender is for a Children's Integrated Speech and Language Therapy Service in Hackney, providing interventions for children with speech, language, communication, or swallowing/eating needs across schools, early years settings, youth services, and as part of the Experts at Hand SEND support initiative. The contract starts April 1, 2027 for an initial 3-year term with two possible 1-year extensions (5 years total).
what_they_want: Speech and Language Therapists to deliver direct interventions for children with Education, Health, and Care Plans (EHCPs), provide professional training, offer parent/carer guidance, and participate in the Hackney Experts at Hand team supporting mainstream education settings with SEND requirements under the Department for Education's initiative.

original_title: Health Checks DPS
english_summary: West Northamptonshire Council is procuring NHS Health Check services for people aged 40-74 to identify and manage cardiovascular disease risk factors. what_they_want: NHS Health Check services for cardiovascular disease screening and risk assessment for adults aged 40-74 years with no previous history of CVD disease. The service must deliver approximately 27,417 to 34,650 health checks per year.
